meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测蛋白质与小分子的结合构象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是从事药物设计或结构生物学的科研人员
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a researcher in drug design or structural biology

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 能进行分子对接：接收蛋白质（PDB 或序列）和配体（SMILES/SDF/MOL2），生成配体的3D结合姿态，并给出每个姿态的置信度分数。支持单个或批量对接，但**不**预测结合亲和力。
howto.when: 当你描述对接任务要求，例如提供蛋白质文件+配体描述，或指定“虚拟筛选”、“预测结合位点”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用 CSV 文件 batch.csv 批量对接 10 个复合物。
say.note: 会依次处理并输出每个复合物的前10个姿态。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to perform molecular docking: accept a protein (PDB or sequence) and a ligand (SMILES/SDF/MOL2), generate 3D binding poses with confidence scores, and support single or batch docking. It does NOT predict binding affinity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user describes a docking task, e.g., providing a protein file and ligand description, or using keywords like "virtual screening" or "predict binding site".

say_en.text: Dock protein.pdb with ligand SMILES CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O.
say_en.note: Runs single docking and outputs top-ranked SDF.

say_en.text: Batch dock 10 complexes using csv file batch.csv.
say_en.note: Processes each complex and outputs top 10 poses per complex.
